articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: The Sandbox pledges 1:1 repayment after $700K bridge exploit
articles.description: Eligible holders on Base and BNB Chain will receive Ethereum-based SAND from the project’s treasury, with claims expected to open within two weeks.

articles.title: Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJ
articles.description: Sheikh Tahnoon’s group reportedly backs a 49% stake in the holding company behind World Liberty’s conditionally approved US trust bank.

articles.title: Virtu, Tradeweb complete onchain repo using Marshall Islands digital bond
articles.description: The transaction used the Marshall Islands-issued USDM1 bond as collateral and completed the full repo cycle on the Canton Network in under 10 minutes.

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.description: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.

articles.title: Mirae Asset lays out crypto, stablecoin, tokenization plans for Digital X
articles.description: The South Korean financial group plans to build a $109 billion digital asset business spanning crypto, stablecoins and tokenized assets, according to The Korea Times.

articles.title: Grayscale says Zcash can challenge Bitcoin’s network effects as privacy demand grows
articles.description: ZEC has climbed roughly 19-fold in a year, yet Grayscale says its sub-1% share of Bitcoin’s market cap leaves room for further upside.

articles.title: Bitcoin eyes $81K as Nvidia earnings beat boosts risk assets
articles.description: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stock markets in fresh gains after Nvidia Q2 earnings beat expectations by around $4 billion.

articles.title: Charles Schwab adda Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to nascent crypto platform
articles.description: The financial services giant plans to expand Schwab Crypto beyond Bitcoin and Ether just months after rolling out direct crypto trading to retail clients.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s 23% rally sends beaten-down miners soaring past AI stocks
articles.description: Canaan, American Bitcoin and Cango jumped as much as 67% as renewed crypto demand showed BTC exposure can still drive mining equities despite the industry’s AI push.

articles.title: UK government reports 240 crypto millionaires in 2025
articles.description: About 17,600 people in the UK reported a combined $1.9 billion in gains tied to crypto in the 2024 to 2025 tax year, with 240 each declaring more than $1.4 million.

articles.title: Ripple Prime expands into US equity derivatives with Delta One business
articles.description: Institutional clients can access total return swaps across linked to US-listed equities, indexes and digital assets and cross-margin exposures.

articles.title: Bank of England set for new innovation mandate covering stablecoins
articles.description: The UK plans to expand the Bank of England’s remit to support digital payments innovation, including stablecoins, while keeping financial stability first.

articles.title: Bitcoin faces true demand test above $83K as liquidity thickens: Glassnode
articles.description: Bitcoin price analysis reveals convergence of multiple trend lines and liquidity structures around spot price, keeping upside in check.

articles.title: Bitfinex Securities completes record $50M tokenized capital raise
articles.description: Bitfinex Securities completed a record $50 million raise for Alkemya, whose token represents interests in a partnership that holds nickel assets.

articles.title: Bithumb wins 2 suits over mistaken Bitcoin credits: Report
articles.description: Bithumb reportedly won first-instance rulings in two suits seeking proceeds from users who sold Bitcoin credited in its $40 billion error.

articles.title: Core Lightning confirms multiple vulnerabilities, prepares security update
articles.description: Core Lightning advised operators to use offline mode if they do not install the forthcoming update, keeping their nodes active but disconnected.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows slow to $232M as BTC holds under $80K
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed to $232.1 million as an eight-day streak reached $2.8 billion, while XRP funds posted their biggest inflow since Jan. 5.

articles.title: Tokenized deposits could raise US credit costs: Dallas Fed economists
articles.description: Dallas Fed economists said faster, programmable deposits could make bank funding less stable, potentially pushing lenders toward more expensive funding.

articles.title: StarkWare tests quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on mainnet
articles.description: StarkWare said the experimental transaction demonstrated quantum-resistant Bitcoin spending without a fork, but it cost up to $200 and required direct miner submission.

articles.title: SHRINCS BIP published: Quantum-secure Bitcoin comes with a catch
articles.description: A new Bitcoin Improvement Proposal for the SHRINCS signature scheme has just been published to upgrade Bitcoin to quantum secure. Here’s everything you need to know.

articles.title: Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by Coinbase
articles.description: Better and Coinbase have launched a crypto-backed mortgage product that lets US homebuyers pledge Bitcoin as collateral for a down payment without having to sell it.

articles.title: Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses most
articles.description: The blockchain analytics firm said just 14% of the onchain activity it identified is covered by the OECD’s international crypto tax-reporting framework.

articles.title: SEC sends crypto custody rule overhaul to White House for review
articles.description: The securities regulator’s crypto custody overhaul could clarify how investment advisers and funds hold digital assets for clients as the proposal moves through review.

articles.title: 77% of Americans see crypto in retirement plans as risky: Survey
articles.description: A new survey finds broad skepticism toward crypto in workplace retirement plans as US policymakers move to expand access to alternative assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $78K as stocks, gold fall on higher US PCE Inflation data
articles.description: Bitcoin stayed away from challenging $80,000 after July US PCE inflation data came in slightly higher than anticipated, pressuring gold and risk assets.

articles.title: Protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution to solve scaling bottlenecks
articles.description: CTDG Dev Hub participant’s protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution, allowing network nodes to reach agreement on blocks before transaction execution completes.

articles.title: SEC’s proposed crypto rules probably won’t spark new ICO boom
articles.description: The SEC’s ‘regulation crypto assets’ proposals could create early-round FOMO. But some tokens may still fall into the no-man’s land between security and non-security.

articles.title: Students want crypto classes but learn on social media: OKX survey
articles.description: A separate review found only about 28% of accredited US business schools offered blockchain courses, despite strong demand in the OKX poll.

articles.title: Bernstein forecasts Bitcoin to reclaim $125K by late 2026 ahead of cycle peak
articles.description: Bernstein expects Bitcoin to reclaim $125,000 by late 2026, before reaching $300,000 in 2029 under its base case, with a bull case of $500,000.
